title: Unscheduled Rain
premise: Rain falls in a perfect rectangle over the coffee table. Nobody moves the magazines. The cat walks around the wet zone as if this is the house rule.
visual: Luxury living room at 2 a.m. A hard-edged shaft of rain, the exact footprint of the glass table, soaking the issues underneath. Dry carpet around it. Two wine glasses, one lipstick-stained. A tiny CRT in the corner playing EyeWash Station snow. A black cat circumnavigates the puddle without looking up.
characterLean: The Two do not comment on weather. The cat already knew.
notes: Seed only — still prompt not locked. Keep the rain rectangular; do not let it become a leak. Not the Ultra-Refreshed plant. Not the hovering melon.
